Syndra.escape: Syndra has no mobility, so the moment after Syndra E Scatter the Weak goes down is your window to engage. Move out of the line of her spheres, then close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. If you didn’t use Talon R Shadow Assault to engage, use its stealth and movement speed to escape.
Syndra.build: Buy boots early to get the movement speed to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, W Force of Will, and E Scatter the Weak on foot. Build magic resistance first against their main magic damage. Also build health to account for the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then throw Talon W Rake right in front of you and land both hits. Follow with a basic attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End. Only if Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down and you’re sure you can secure the kill, use the fast sequence: jump with Q immediately after Talon W Rake’s first hit, then activate Talon R Shadow Assault mid-jump.
Syndra.fight: Immediately after Syndra E Scatter the Weak goes down, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when she steps forward to last-hit. Land both hits of Talon W Rake at close range, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack, then disengage.
Syndra.laning: As a melee Talon, don’t step forward first; chip away with Talon W Rake. When Syndra steps up to last-hit, look for a chance to close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy instead of Talon E Assassin's Path. After shoving the wave, roam over walls along paths without vision.
Syndra.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your roaming and burst peak, so apply pressure during this window. Talon’s influence falls as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure that can close out the game while ahead.
Syndra.teamfight: If you’ve chosen Syndra as your target, engage after Syndra E Scatter the Weak has been used on your allies. Avoid areas with several Syndra Q Dark Sphere spheres on the ground. If engaging from the front is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and focus your abilities on one target. It’s safer to save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.
Syndra.watch: Syndra E Scatter the Weak knocks you back and slows you; if you’re hit by a Syndra Q Dark Sphere that has been knocked back, you’re stunned. If you see a sphere between you and Syndra, move out of its line. Also watch for the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power where several spheres are on the ground.

Naafiri.phase: Naafiri’s roams are most dangerous in the mid game, so maintain broad vision. Talon should shove the wave, then move along paths without vision. In the late game, Talon’s influence falls and Naafiri’s pack is vulnerable to area damage in front-to-back team fights, so group with your team and avoid getting picked off.
Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals physical damage, so prioritize armor and add health when you need more survivability. If fights drag on because of the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Naafiri.combo: For a reliable trade, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, land both hits of Talon W Rake at close range, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack. Save your targeted abilities during the brief window when Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, then use your combo after it ends.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t engage just because Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers is down; also check Naafiri E Eviscerate and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit. In particular, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path when Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is still unavailable and Naafiri W The Call of the Pack has also ended.
Naafiri.fight: Immediately after Naafiri E Eviscerate revives the pack, clear the pack before you counterattack. If the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers applies a bleed, don’t go in immediately; wait for it to end, then account for Naafiri’s remaining mobility before engaging.
Naafiri.laning: Use Talon W Rake to chip away at Naafiri’s health while preserving mana early, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when she steps forward to last-hit.
Naafiri.teamfight: Choose one target and focus your abilities on them. Engage from the flank with Talon E Assassin's Path after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allies. It’s safer to save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape, and if an ally dies to Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit, retreat immediately to avoid getting picked off in succession.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once and applies a bleed, create distance until it ends to avoid the second hit. Save your targeted abilities during the brief window when Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, and don’t roam alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available.

Ahri.build: Get a way to interrupt or cleanse Ahri E Charm first, and build magic resistance against Ahri's magic damage. You cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return with magic resistance, so you need enough health to withstand it. If healing from Ahri P Essence Theft is having a strong impact, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Ahri.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then cast Talon W Rake at close range to hit with both the outgoing and returning strikes. Follow with an auto attack to proc Talon P Blade's End. Starting this sequence after Ahri E Charm is down reduces the risk of engaging.
Ahri.escape: Go in right after Ahri E Charm is down and during periods when Ahri R Spirit Rush is unavailable. Close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path. Whenever possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault to use its stealth to escape.
Ahri.fight: Engage right after dodging Ahri E Charm from behind minions or while Ahri R Spirit Rush is down. If you close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, hit both strikes of Talon W Rake at close range, proc Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack, then disengage.
Ahri.laning: Talon has short range, so don't step forward first. Keep minions between you and Ahri to dodge Ahri E Charm. Poke with Talon W Rake while conserving mana early, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Ahri steps forward to last-hit.
Ahri.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your burst and roaming become stronger. Push the wave, then use Talon E Assassin's Path to cross terrain and create a numbers advantage on a side lane. Talon's influence falls as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while ahead.
Ahri.teamfight: Engage after Ahri E Charm is down and the enemy's crowd control has been used on your team. Use Talon E Assassin's Path to flank and focus your abilities on one target. It's safer to save the stealth from Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.
Ahri.watch: Stay behind minions to avoid Ahri E Charm, since getting hit can leave you open to her full combo. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on its return, so keep moving outside its return path even after dodging the first hit.

Ambessa.fight: Start a trade right after Ambessa uses her abilities and the charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. Don't attack during the windup of Ambessa W Repudiation; back away, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy after it ends. Don't just hit with abilities and retreat; follow with an auto attack to proc Talon P Blade's End.
Ambessa.build: Build armor before magic resistance against Ambessa's main damage. Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. If the healing from Ambessa R Public Execution is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Ambessa.combo: After Ambessa W Repudiation is down, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and hit both outgoing and returning strikes of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with an auto attack to proc Talon P Blade's End. If you're at a distance where Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam is difficult to dodge, move close to her so you don't stay at the blade's tip.
Ambessa.escape: Talon's window to engage opens right after Ambessa uses all her abilities and the charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step. In particular, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate and the shield from Ambessa W Repudiation are down. Choose the terrain to cross with Talon E Assassin's Path in advance so you have an escape route.
Ambessa.laning: Talon has short range, so poke with Talon W Rake instead of stepping forward first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Ambessa steps forward to last-hit. Use Talon W Rake at close range to hit both strikes, but conserve mana early so you have enough for a kill opportunity.
Ambessa.phase: Ambessa is strong in the mid game as she builds core items, so avoid giving up kills early and keep up in levels. Talon's influence falls later in the game, so while ahead, keep up the pressure by pushing waves and roaming with Talon E Assassin's Path.
Ambessa.teamfight: Choose one target before engaging, then flank with Talon E Assassin's Path after the enemy's crowd control has been used on your team. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the enemy champion farthest along a straight line, so don't stand in line with your team's backline. If possible, save the stealth from Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.
Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup of Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and walk out of range. The blade tips of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam are dangerous, so dodge the first hit; if it's hard to avoid, move close to her. If hit by Ambessa E Lacerate, don't wait for the slow to wear off; move immediately with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or E Assassin's Path.

Akshan.teamfight: Choose your target before engaging and focus Talon's abilities on one person. Engage after the enemy's crowd control has been used on your team, flanking with Talon E Assassin's Path. It's safer to save R Shadow Assault for your escape. If Akshan has marked you as his Scoundrel, avoid facing him alone and fight outside his execution range to prevent the revive from Akshan W Going Rogue.
Akshan.build: Buy armor first. Akshan Q Avengerang, E Heroic Swing, and R Comeuppance deal primarily physical damage, so prioritize armor. Basic attacks and attack speed are also central to his damage, so use ways to reduce his attack speed if available.
Akshan.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then cast Talon W Rake at close range to hit both strikes. Follow with an auto attack to proc Talon P Blade's End. For a quick finish, cast Talon W Rake first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns and follow with an auto attack.
Akshan.escape: The moment after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or E Assassin's Path, but if you use E Assassin's Path, choose your escape terrain beforehand. It's safer to save the stealth and movement speed from Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.
Akshan.fight: Right after you make Akshan use E Heroic Swing, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and fight. Once you start trading, hit both strikes of Talon W Rake and follow with an auto attack to proc Talon P Blade's End. Akshan P Dirty Fighting grants a shield and movement speed, so avoid trades where you only build up stacks with abilities before backing off.
Akshan.laning: Poke with Talon W Rake, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Akshan steps forward to last-hit. Akshan Q Avengerang gains range when it hits minions, so avoid standing behind the wave and getting poked.
Akshan.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, push the wave and roam with E Assassin's Path to create a numbers advantage. Talon's influence falls later in the game, so keep up the pressure while ahead.
Akshan.watch: Each time Akshan Q Avengerang hits an enemy, its range increases, so dodge both its outgoing and returning paths even when you are behind minions. Akshan E Heroic Swing lets him engage and disengage using walls, so watch for him to use it near terrain. If Akshan R Comeuppance targets you at low health, move behind terrain instead of trying to escape alone through open ground.

Akali.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, hit both outgoing and returning strikes of Talon W Rake at close range, then proc Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack. For a quick trade, cast Talon W Rake first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns and follow with an auto attack. In this sequence, don't auto attack before Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy.
Akali.build: Build magic resistance first. It helps against Akali's main damage, and getting health as well can help you avoid the range where the missing-health scaling damage of Akali R Perfect Execution becomes greater.
Akali.escape: Don't engage just because one of Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali R Perfect Execution is down. In particular, before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when her other mobility tools are also down. Decide beforehand whether to use Talon E Assassin's Path to engage or save it for terrain you can use to escape.
Akali.fight: Dodge the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip, then fight back when she comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack. If your abilities hit, follow with an auto attack to proc Talon P Blade's End, then disengage.
Akali.laning: Talon has short range, so don't step forward first; poke with Talon W Rake. Close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Akali steps forward to last-hit, but don't spam Talon W Rake and run out of mana.
Akali.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, push the wave and roam with Talon E Assassin's Path to apply pressure. Talon's influence falls as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while ahead.
Akali.teamfight: Choose one target and focus your abilities on them. Engage after the enemy's crowd control has been used on your team. If a frontal engage is difficult, flank the backline with Talon E Assassin's Path. It's safer to save the stealth from Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, the second dash will follow Talon as he retreats. You can't dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution on foot, so save Talon E Assassin's Path while Akali is close and use it to create distance when she engages.

Corki.laning: Early on, chip Corki’s health with Talon W Rake, but don’t spam it and run out of mana. When Corki steps forward to last-hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and follow up with an auto attack. When you push the wave to roam, clear enemy vision or take a route without vision with Talon E Assassin’s Path.
Corki.build: Build armor first against Corki E Gatling Gun and Corki R Missile Barrage. Corki P Hextech Munitions deals true damage that resistances cannot block, so build some health too. Prioritize getting out of Corki E Gatling Gun’s range before building more resistance.
Corki.combo: If Corki W Valkyrie is down, close in first with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then cast Talon W Rake at close range to hit both the outgoing and returning strikes. Follow with an auto attack to trigger Talon P Blade’s End. If you need to engage quickly, cast Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then auto attack.
Corki.escape: Engage right after you force Corki to use Corki W Valkyrie. Close the gap during that window with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin’s Path. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape rather than engage.
Corki.fight: The moment Corki W Valkyrie is down is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, hit both passes of Talon W Rake, then trigger Talon P Blade’s End with an auto attack. Don’t fight for long while taking Corki E Gatling Gun head-on; retreat once the trade is done.
Corki.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your roaming and burst get stronger, so limit Corki’s time to farm. The longer the game goes, the less influence Talon has while Corki grows stronger as he gathers items, so keep pressuring him while ahead.
Corki.teamfight: Choose one target before engaging and focus Talon’s abilities on that target. After the enemy team’s crowd control has been used on an ally, flank with Talon E Assassin’s Path to reach the back line. It is safer to save Talon R Shadow Assault’s invisibility and movement speed for your escape.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets near the first one it hits, so don’t hide behind minions; move out of range. In particular, reposition so you don’t get hit by the third missile in a row. If Corki E Gatling Gun hits you, it reduces your armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of staying in front of it.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health and builds Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its aim. At low health, avoid Aurelion Sol E Singularity, which can execute you; if caught in it, walk out immediately. Spread out from your allies before engaging to avoid being hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.build: Build magic resistance first against Aurelion Sol's main damage. Consider movement speed to escape Aurelion Sol E Singularity and enough health to avoid its execute threshold, but don't stack health alone because of Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light.
AurelionSol.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then hit both outgoing and returning strikes of Talon W Rake at close range and proc Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack. For a quick combo, cast Talon W Rake first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before the returning strike and follow with an auto attack. In this sequence, don't auto attack before Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy.
AurelionSol.escape: Engage after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down and you've left the area of Aurelion Sol E Singularity. It's safer to go in after the crowd control from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend has been used. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.
AurelionSol.fight: Right after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path. Once you start a trade, hit with abilities in quick succession to stack Talon P Blade's End, then proc it with an auto attack and disengage. Move out of Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light's aim so you don't take it for long while approaching.
AurelionSol.laning: Reduce health with Talon W Rake, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Aurelion Sol steps forward to last-hit. While waiting for poke, stand behind minions and avoid unnecessary hits that build Stardust.
AurelionSol.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, push the wave and roam with Talon E Assassin's Path to apply pressure. Aurelion Sol builds permanent Stardust later in the game while Talon's influence falls, so keep up the pressure to end the game while ahead.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Spread out and avoid grouping in narrow passages so several allies aren't hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. After the enemy's crowd control has been used on your team, choose one target and focus your abilities on them. If a frontal engage is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.

Karma.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Karma’s main damage. If the healing from Karma R Mantra-empowered W is potent, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Karma.escape: Engage during the window after Karma W Focused Resolve is down to reduce the risk of being rooted. Wait for Karma E Inspire’s movement speed boost and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E to expire, then close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Keep Talon R Shadow Assault available for your escape if possible.
Karma.fight: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Karma steps forward to last-hit. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is active, delay your engage until it expires. Once you start a trade, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack, then disengage.
Karma.teamfight: Engage after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E has expired. Pick one target and focus your abilities on them. If a direct engage is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and target the backline. Use Talon R Shadow Assault to escape if possible.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame slows and deals AoE damage, so stand behind minions or outside its range to avoid being hit. If you’re hit by the fire ring from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, move out of the ring before it detonates a moment later. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break it before you’re rooted.
Karma.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then land both the outgoing and returning hits of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with a basic attack to proc Talon P Blade’s End. For a quick trade, cast Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then follow with a basic attack.
Karma.laning: Talon has short range, so don’t step forward first. Chip away at your opponent’s health with Talon W Rake. Don’t spam W and run out of mana you need for a kill opportunity.
Karma.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, Talon’s burst and roaming power increase. Push the wave and use Talon E Assassin’s Path to cross walls and pressure the side lanes. Talon’s influence falls off as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while you have an advantage.

Kassadin.build: Build magic resistance before armor to prepare for Kassadin Q Null Sphere, W Nether Blade, and E Force Pulse. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana, not health, so there’s no reason to prioritize Grievous Wounds.
Kassadin.escape: The moment after Kassadin R Riftwalk is down is an opportunity to close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. If Kassadin E Force Pulse is also down, you have less reason to worry about its slow. Before engaging, choose terrain to cross with Talon E Assassin's Path, and save Talon R Shadow Assault’s stealth for your escape.
Kassadin.laning: Use Talon W Rake when you have a chance to hit both strikes at close range, and avoid spamming it from far away so you don’t run out of mana. Casting unnecessary abilities near Kassadin reduces Kassadin E Force Pulse’s cooldown, so clear waves from a distance when possible.
Kassadin.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, push the wave and roam with Talon E Assassin's Path to create a numbers advantage. Talon’s influence falls off as the game goes longer, while Kassadin’s backline engage becomes threatening, so keep up the pressure while you’re ahead.
Kassadin.teamfight: Pick one target in advance and focus your abilities on them. After the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your team, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and target the backline. Don’t stand alone within Kassadin R Riftwalk’s range, and use Talon R Shadow Assault to escape after engaging if possible.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin E Force Pulse slows you and makes it difficult to disengage after a trade, so engage after it is down. Kassadin Q Null Sphere grants a shield, but Talon’s main physical damage is effective against Kassadin’s low armor.
Kassadin.combo: For a reliable trade, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then cast Talon W Rake at close range and land both hits. Follow with a basic attack to proc Talon P Blade’s End. To finish quickly, cast Talon W Rake first and close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, without using a basic attack beforehand.
Kassadin.fight: Land both hits of Talon W Rake at close range, proc Talon P Blade’s End with a basic attack, then back off.

Leblanc.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor to prepare for LeBlanc’s ability damage. Before stacking more magic resistance, consider prioritizing a spell shield to interrupt combos that start with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice. Movement speed is also useful for walking out of telegraphed areas.
Leblanc.combo: For a reliable combo, wait for LeBlanc W Distortion’s return to expire or be used, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Hit both the outgoing and returning strikes of Talon W Rake at close range, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack. For a quick combo, throw Talon W Rake first and close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before the returning strike, without basic attacking beforehand.
Leblanc.escape: The moment after LeBlanc W Distortion is down is an opportunity to engage with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. If you’re hit by LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, don’t wait for the root; use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path to get out of chain range. Saving Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape lets you use its stealth and movement speed.
Leblanc.fight: When LeBlanc W Distortion is down, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. If you’re caught by LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path to get out of chain range before the root, then look for another opportunity. If you start a trade at close range, follow through with a basic attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End, then disengage.
Leblanc.laning: Chip away at her health with Talon W Rake instead of stepping forward first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when LeBlanc moves up to last-hit. If LeBlanc disappears from vision, alert your team immediately.
Leblanc.teamfight: Choose a target in advance and focus your abilities on them. Engage after enemy crowd control, including LeBlanc’s root, has been used on your team, and it’s safer to save Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape. If a direct engage is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and target the backline.
Leblanc.watch: If you’re marked by LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, her next ability can deal heavy damage, so back off until the mark disappears. If you’re hit by LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, get out of range before the root takes hold. LeBlanc can return to her original position after using LeBlanc W Distortion, so look for an opportunity when the return expires or is used.
Leblanc.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, Talon’s burst and roaming get stronger. Push the wave and use Talon E Assassin’s Path to pressure the side lanes. Talon’s influence falls off as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while you have an advantage.

Lissandra.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Lissandra’s main damage. Armor does not help against Lissandra’s magic damage. If the enemy team has a champion with strong healing, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Lissandra.combo: For a reliable combo, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, hit both strikes of Talon W Rake at close range, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack. For a quick combo, throw Talon W Rake first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before Rake returns and follow with a basic attack. If Lissandra can put herself in stasis with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, time your combo so your damage isn’t wasted during it.
Lissandra.escape: The moment after Lissandra E Glacial Path is used is a window to engage with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, it’s a good time to trade without worrying about its root. There’s no information indicating Talon has an immobilizing ability that can stop Lissandra E Glacial Path from being recast, so close the gap after she finishes moving.
Lissandra.fight: Trade right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is also down, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, she can use its stasis to avoid burst damage, so don’t deal all your damage at once.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle from allied minions to avoid Lissandra Q Ice Shard’s piercing path. Use Talon W Rake to chip away at her health while saving mana early, and engage when Lissandra steps forward to last-hit or just after she uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost. After pushing the wave, roam with Talon E Assassin's Path along a path without vision.
Lissandra.teamfight: Engage after crowd control such as Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb has been used on your team. Pick one target and focus your abilities on them, and check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path has been fully expended before deciding whether to chase. If a direct engage is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and save Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting an allied minion, so don’t stand in a line with minions. Lissandra W Ring of Frost roots and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb stuns, making it easy to take a burst of damage if you’re caught, so don’t engage recklessly while both abilities are available.
Lissandra.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, Talon’s roaming and burst are at their peak. Push the wave and pressure the side lanes. Talon’s influence falls off as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while you have an advantage.

Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Malzahar’s main damage. If you need to remove the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp yourself, get Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. R also deals damage based on max health, so be careful about investing heavily in health alone.
Malzahar.combo: For a reliable combo, break Malzahar P Void Shift first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, hit both strikes of Talon W Rake at close range, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack. If a direct engage is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and target the side of the backline. Save Talon R Shadow Assault’s stealth for your escape if possible.
Mel.watch: If you’re hit by the center of Mel E Solar Snare, you’ll be rooted and Mel Q Radiant Volley may follow, so sidestep it. Mel W Rebuttal can send Talon W Rake back, so use W after Rebuttal is down. If you’ve been hit by several pokes, watch out for the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance even if you still have health, and after a fight, stay somewhere safe until the stacks disappear to prepare for Mel R Golden Eclipse.

Land both the outgoing and returning hits, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack. After the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allies, choose one target and focus your abilities on them. If engaging from the front is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path. Engage with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, hit both strikes of Talon W Rake, proc Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack, then disengage. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, go in with an ally so you can also destroy her egg.

Avoid narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape, and start fights in open areas. Engage after the enemy's crowd control has been used on your team, flanking with Talon E Assassin's Path. Save Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost stuns when it explodes, and Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage after it hits, so dodge the explosion radius rather than just moving slightly aside from its path. If hit by Q, don't continue trading; escape Anivia R Glacial Storm with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path to avoid the next Frostbite. Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape in narrow paths.

Annie.combo: For a reliable hit, close in on Annie with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, cast Talon W Rake at close range to hit both the outgoing and returning strikes, then proc Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack. Annie.fight: Fight after Annie P Pyromania's stun is down, when Annie steps forward to last-hit. If you close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, hit both strikes of Talon W Rake and follow with an auto attack to proc Talon P Blade's End, then disengage.

Use Talon W Rake at close range to hit both strikes, but don't spam it and run low on mana early. When pushing the wave and moving to roam, cross terrain along a route without vision with Talon E Assassin's Path.
Annie.phase: If Annie reaches the next level first, don't step forward during that window. After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, use your roaming and burst to apply pressure and secure your lead before the game reaches the late stage, when your influence falls.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is out of sight or Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, avoid standing stacked with your allies so Annie R Summon: Tibbers can't engage on several of you at once with its area damage. After Annie's crowd control has been used on your team, choose one target and focus your abilities on them. If a frontal engage is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and save Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.
Annie.watch: When white light swirls around Annie, Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, so stay out of her ability range. Annie R Summon: Tibbers deals area damage and continues burning nearby enemies after it is summoned, so keep your distance from Tibbers even if you've killed Annie.

If only one of Aurora’s mobility spells is down, she may escape with the other, so check whether she has used it.

If Aurora E The Weirding creates distance, check her remaining mobility before re-engaging. Once you start a trade, follow up with an auto attack to trigger Talon P Blade’s End, then retreat.

Aurora.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, use your stronger roaming and burst to push the wave and pressure a side lane with Talon E Assassin’s Path. Talon’s influence falls off later, so keep up the pressure while ahead.

If Aurora W Across the Veil is down and a takedown has not reset its cooldown, you have a chance to kill her. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape, and use Talon E Assassin’s Path to flank if a direct engage is difficult.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when it returns and is more dangerous the more health you are missing. If you are cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora. If your health is low, back away before it returns. After Aurora R Between Worlds opens, leaving the area slows you, so decide whether to retreat before it appears.

Hwei.laning: Talon has short range, so instead of stepping forward first, chip Hwei’s health with Talon W Rake and look for the moment he comes forward to last-hit. Talon W Rake has a high mana cost early, so don’t spam it.
Hwei.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your burst and roaming both get stronger, so push the wave and target a side lane with Talon E Assassin’s Path. Talon’s influence falls off as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while ahead.
Hwei.teamfight: Engage after Hwei E Subject: Torment has been used on an ally, and approach Hwei from the side with Talon E Assassin’s Path. Hwei has no mobility, so once you get close, focus your abilities on him and go for the kill. It is safer to save Talon R Shadow Assault’s invisibility for your escape.
Hwei.watch: If you are caught by the root or pull from Hwei E Subject: Torment, you may take all the follow-up damage, so don’t dive in first while that ability is available. If one of Hwei’s abilities hits you, reposition immediately to avoid the second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on max health, so go around corridors covered by its ground effect.

Irelia.build: If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge is a problem, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items. The bleed from Talon P Blade’s End makes it easy to keep Grievous Wounds active.
Irelia.combo: For a reliable trade, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then cast Talon W Rake at close range. Land the returning hit too, then proc Talon P Blade’s End with a basic attack. For a quick trade, cast Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then follow with a basic attack.
Irelia.escape: Engage right after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, especially after you’ve also avoided the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. Close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and use Talon E Assassin’s Path to cross terrain, but choose your escape terrain in advance.
Irelia.fight: Right after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge is your chance to close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Get close enough to land both hits of Talon W Rake, proc Talon P Blade’s End with a basic attack, then back off.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a half-health minion between you and Irelia that she can use to dash in with Q Bladesurge. When she steps forward to last-hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Use Talon W Rake sparingly so you retain enough mana for a kill opportunity.
Irelia.phase: Once you learn Talon R Shadow Assault, push the wave and pressure the map by roaming with Talon E Assassin’s Path. Talon’s influence falls off as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while you have an advantage.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a big impact in teamfights, so prioritize Irelia as a target. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your team, focus your abilities on one target, and save Talon R Shadow Assault’s stealth to escape.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain-dash through low-health minions to close the distance, so keep away when minions are about to die. Avoid the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Lux.build: Build movement speed first so it’s easier to leave the spot marked by Lux E Lucent Singularity. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance over armor.
Lux.combo: If Lux Q Light Binding misses, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and land both the outgoing and returning hits of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with a basic attack to proc Talon P Blade’s End.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility ability, so close the distance when Lux Q Light Binding misses. If you can cross terrain from the side, approach with Talon E Assassin’s Path; within range, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy.
Lux.fight: Your chance to engage comes right after you bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding. When Lux steps forward to last-hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, build up stacks with your abilities, then proc Talon P Blade’s End with a basic attack and back off.
Lux.laning: Talon has short range, so instead of stepping forward first, chip away at Lux’s health with Talon W Rake and look for her when she comes out to last-hit. Lux Q Light Binding can pass through its first target and hit up to two, so don’t stand in line with your allies.
Lux.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, Talon’s roaming and burst get stronger. Push the wave and take a flanking route with Talon E Assassin’s Path. Talon’s influence falls off as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while you have an advantage.
Lux.teamfight: Spread out from your allies and approach from different directions so Lux E Lucent Singularity can’t catch you all at once. Engage from the side after crowd control such as Lux Q Light Binding is used on your team, and focus your damage on Lux. It’s safer to save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, she can easily follow up with her other abilities, so bait it out and engage after it misses. Leave the area marked by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and sidestep when you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark. If Lux’s abilities hit you, create distance so she can’t land a basic attack while Lux P Illumination is on you.

Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first against Neeko’s main damage. If being rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom kills you, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, land both the outgoing and returning hits of Talon W Rake at close range, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack. For a faster engage, throw Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then basic attack. In this sequence, don’t basic attack before Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy.
Neeko.escape: The moment after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs goes down is your window to engage with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Before going in, choose the terrain you’ll cross with Talon E Assassin's Path to escape.
Neeko.fight: Immediately after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs goes down, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and force a trade. Land both hits of Talon W Rake at close range, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack, then disengage.
Neeko.laning: Rather than stepping forward first as a short-ranged Talon, chip away with Talon W Rake, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Neeko steps up to last-hit. Talon W Rake costs a lot of mana early, so don’t spam it.
Neeko.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, shove the wave and roam over walls with Talon E Assassin's Path to create a numbers advantage. Talon’s influence falls as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while ahead.
Neeko.teamfight: An opponent disguised by Neeko P Inherent Glamour can close in, so if you suspect someone’s identity, spread out early to avoid Neeko R Pop Blossom. After the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allies, choose one target and focus your abilities on them. If engaging from the front is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path. It’s safer to save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up after hitting something, so don’t stand in line with an ally or behind them. Move outside the range of Neeko R Pop Blossom when its cast animation appears. When a disguised Neeko approaches, spread out in advance instead of waiting for the cast animation.

Qiyana.build: Buy armor items first against the main damage from Qiyana P Royal Privilege, Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, and E Audacity. You have little need to buy extra magic resistance for the magic damage from Qiyana W Terrashape. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent scales with your maximum health, so avoid choices that only stack health.
Qiyana.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, land both hits of Talon W Rake at close range, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack. For a faster combo, throw Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then basic attack; don’t basic attack before Q.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t rush in just because Qiyana W Terrashape is down; she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity. Close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or E Assassin's Path before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up, especially while Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal’s root and R Supreme Display of Talent’s stun are also used.
Qiyana.fight: Counterattack after Qiyana uses W Terrashape and E Audacity and remains in front of you. In particular, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up. Once you start trading, follow through with a basic attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End.
Qiyana.laning: Rather than stepping forward to fight first, chip away with Talon W Rake, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Qiyana steps up to last-hit. After shoving the wave, clear enemy vision or choose a path without vision when roaming.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so avoid giving her an advantage then. Both champions have relatively less influence in the late game, so Talon should keep up the pressure while ahead.
Qiyana.teamfight: After the enemy’s crowd control has been used, pick one target and focus your abilities on them. You can flank with Talon E Assassin's Path, but stay away from walls and narrow passages to avoid getting caught by Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root you when she has the river element, so move out of range if she approaches with it. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes on hitting a wall and stuns, so don’t fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow passage.

Ryze.build: Ryze’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Also consider movement speed to get out of the telegraphed areas of Ryze Q Overload, W Rune Prison, and E Spell Flux.
Ryze.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then land both the outgoing and returning hits of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with one basic attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End. If you need to engage quickly, throw Talon W Rake first and close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, but don’t basic attack beforehand.
Ryze.escape: If you dodged Ryze E Spell Flux or its mark has disappeared, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows instead of rooting, making it a good time to engage. Before crossing terrain with Talon E Assassin's Path, choose your escape route back in advance.
Ryze.fight: Close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Ryze steps forward to last-hit. Land both hits of Talon W Rake at close range, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack, then disengage.
Ryze.laning: Use Talon W Rake to chip away at Ryze’s health early while preserving mana. After shoving the wave, choose a path without vision and roam with Talon E Assassin's Path.
Ryze.phase: Ryze lacks mana and damage early, so Talon should pressure him by reaching levels first and trading to slow his growth. After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your roaming and burst become stronger, so keep up the pressure while ahead. Talon’s influence falls as the game goes on, so choose your targets carefully in the late game.
Ryze.teamfight: Taking sustained damage while giving Ryze space refreshes the mark, so choose a target, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, and focus your damage on one enemy. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allies, and save the stealth from Talon R Shadow Assault to escape. If engaging from the front is difficult, flank the back line with Talon E Assassin's Path.
Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, keep your distance from allies until the mark disappears. While marked, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you, and the damage from Ryze Q Overload is amplified and bounces to nearby targets. Prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux, and don’t engage immediately after being hit by Ryze W Rune Prison.

Sylas.build: Fit Executioner's Calling between your core items to counter the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer. Talon P Blade's End applies a bleed over time, making it easy to maintain Grievous Wounds. The resistance you need against Sylas’s main damage is magic resistance, not armor.
Sylas.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then throw Talon W Rake at close range and land both hits. Follow with one basic attack to trigger the bleed from Talon P Blade's End. For a faster combo, throw Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then basic attack.
Sylas.escape: Dodge the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct; your chance to engage comes when Sylas W Kingslayer is also down. Close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path during that window. Sylas’s chains can interrupt Talon E Assassin's Path, so save it until you dodge them, and keep Talon R Shadow Assault as an escape tool.
Sylas.fight: When Sylas steps up to last-hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy for a short trade. Land both hits of Talon W Rake at close range, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack, then disengage. If Sylas W Kingslayer is available, be careful not to merely chip away at health and postpone finishing him.
Sylas.laning: Talon W Rake costs a lot of mana, so don’t spam it. After shoving the wave, check vision as you roam.
Sylas.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your roaming and burst become stronger, so use Talon E Assassin's Path to create a numbers advantage in side lanes. Talon’s influence falls as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while ahead.
Sylas.teamfight: Right after Sylas engages with E Abscond / Abduct, he is at his weakest before healing with Sylas W Kingslayer, so focus him with your allies. When engaging yourself, wait until the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allies, then flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and focus your abilities on one target. It’s safer to save the stealth from Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.
Sylas.watch: The first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct deals no damage, but if its follow-up chains hit you, they knock you up and let him land a combo. Time Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path to dodge the chains, not the first dash. Sylas Q Chain Lash’s intersection explodes after a delay, so move away immediately even if the first hit only grazes you.

TwistedFate.build: Build magic resistance first against damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, W Pick a Card, and E Stacked Deck. The provided information isn’t enough to determine the purchase order for specific items.
TwistedFate.combo: For a reliable hit, wait until Twisted Fate’s gold card is down, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then throw W Rake at close range and land both the outgoing and returning hits. Follow immediately with a basic attack to trigger P Blade's End.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used is a safe opportunity to engage. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.
TwistedFate.fight: When Twisted Fate steps forward to last-hit without holding a gold card from W Pick a Card, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Land both hits of Talon W Rake at close range, trigger P Blade's End with a basic attack, then disengage.
TwistedFate.laning: Rather than stepping forward first, chip away with Talon W Rake, but conserve mana early so you can use it for a kill opportunity. When you shove and roam, alert your allies to your movements in case of Twisted Fate R Destiny, and use Talon E Assassin's Path along paths without vision.
TwistedFate.phase: Talon’s influence falls as the game goes on, so keep up the pressure while ahead.
TwistedFate.teamfight: After Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and focus your abilities on Twisted Fate. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allies, and it’s safer to save Talon R Shadow Assault to escape.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has locked in a gold card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his basic attack range. Stand behind minions to reduce poke damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.

Veigar.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can dodge the marked area of Veigar W Dark Matter. Veigar Q Baleful Strike, W Dark Matter, and R Primordial Burst all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance if you want resistance.
Veigar.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, land both strikes of Talon W Rake at close range, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack. For a faster combo, throw Talon W Rake first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before Rake returns and follow with an auto attack. In this sequence, do not auto attack before Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy.
Veigar.escape: Look for an opening when Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Veigar has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or cross terrain with Talon E Assassin's Path to approach. If Veigar E Event Horizon traps you, don’t rush into the edge; save Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and E Assassin's Path to escape.
Veigar.fight: When Veigar steps forward to last-hit, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Once you start a trade, hit both strikes of Talon W Rake at close range, trigger Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack, then back off. Veigar E Event Horizon being down is your window to engage.
Veigar.phase: Talon deals strong damage early, while Veigar has low armor, so this is a chance to pressure him. After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, push the wave and roam with Talon E Assassin's Path to build an advantage. Veigar's growth stacks permanently, while Talon's impact falls off as the game goes on, so keep pressuring while you have the advantage.
Veigar.teamfight: Choose a target before engaging, and check Veigar’s position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon. After the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allies, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and focus your damage on one target. It is safer to save Talon R Shadow Assault to help you escape.
Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge. If trapped inside, don’t run into the edge; move around inside and wait for it to disappear. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where it will land, so dodge to the side. If you are below half health, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Vex.build: Against Vex’s damage, consider magic resistance before armor. Also consider movement speed so you can walk out of marked attack areas. Since a mark is applied after a dash, consider tenacity too.
Vex.combo: For a reliable hit, wait until Vex’s Doom empowerment has been spent, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and land both strikes of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with an auto attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End. If you need a faster combo, throw W first and close in with Q just before it returns, but don’t auto attack before Q.
Vex.escape: Engage during the window when the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been used and the shield from Vex W Personal Space is down. If you approach with Talon E Assassin's Path, decide in advance which terrain you’ll use to leave.
Vex.fight: Engage when both the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom and the shield from Vex W Personal Space are down. When Vex steps forward to last-hit, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, chain your abilities, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack. If you are marked with Gloom, back out of Vex’s auto attack range after the trade.
Vex.laning: Talon has short range, so poke with Talon W Rake instead of stepping forward first, and look for an opening when Vex moves up to last-hit. Don’t waste mana by spamming W and lose the mana you need for a kill opportunity. After pushing the wave, check enemy vision and roam over terrain with Talon E Assassin's Path.
Vex.phase: If Vex reaches the next level first, don’t step forward. After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your roaming and burst damage become stronger, so keep applying pressure. Avoid reckless engages late in the game when your impact falls off.
Vex.teamfight: Before the fight, move low-health allies out of range so Vex R Shadow Surge cannot trigger a chain of damage with its first kill. After Vex’s crowd control has been used on your allies, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path and focus your abilities on one target. If possible, use Talon R Shadow Assault to escape after engaging.
Vex.watch: When the Doom indicator from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is visible, don’t dash with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or E Assassin's Path. Wait for the moment immediately after Vex spends Doom on the wave or to poke. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger over distance, so if you are in range, make a short sidestep.

Viktor.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can get out of marked areas. Viktor’s damage is magic damage, so choose magic resistance if you want resistance.
Viktor.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, land both strikes of Talon W Rake at close range, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack. If you can engage quickly from outside Viktor W Gravity Field, throw Talon W Rake first, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns and follow with an auto attack. In this second sequence, don’t auto attack before Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so engage when Viktor W Gravity Field is down or when you can avoid its area. Close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, and if you can use a wall, approach from the side with Talon E Assassin's Path. It is safer to save Talon R Shadow Assault to help you escape.
Viktor.fight: Instead of closing in first, poke with Talon W Rake, then engage with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Viktor steps forward to last-hit. Don’t continue trading inside Viktor W Gravity Field; leave immediately. After landing your abilities, follow with an auto attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End.
Viktor.laning: Don’t stand where Viktor E Hextech Ray can pass through the wave and hit you. After pushing the lane, check vision and roam over a wall with Talon E Assassin's Path.
Viktor.phase: Early on, Viktor has not yet built stacks on Viktor P Glorious Evolution, so Talon has a chance to pressure him with level advantages and trades. After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, use your roaming and burst damage to extend your lead. Viktor grows stronger over time as Talon's impact falls off, so keep pressuring while you have the advantage.
Viktor.teamfight: Choose one target in advance, and engage after crowd control such as Viktor W Gravity Field has been used on your allies. If approaching from the front is difficult, flank Viktor with Talon E Assassin's Path. Focus your abilities on one target and save Talon R Shadow Assault’s stealth for your escape.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray is a straight-line skillshot, so don’t stand in line with the wave; dodge to the side. Leave Viktor W Gravity Field immediately to avoid being stunned. Viktor Q Siphon Power gives him a shield and movement speed, so be cautious about trading right after he uses it.

Vladimir.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Vladimir’s damage. If the healing from Vladimir Q Transfusion, W Sanguine Pool, and R Hemoplague becomes a problem in extended fights, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Talon P Blade's End’s bleed makes it easy to maintain Grievous Wounds.
Vladimir.combo: After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends, for a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and throw Talon W Rake at close range, landing both the outgoing and returning strikes. Follow with one auto attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End. For a faster combo, throw Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then auto attack.
Vladimir.escape: When Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends, you have a chance to engage. Vladimir moves more slowly while charging E Tides of Blood, so position to dodge the wave and close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Save Talon R Shadow Assault to help you escape.
Vladimir.fight: When Vladimir steps forward to last-hit, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. Land both strikes of Talon W Rake at close range, trigger Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack, then back off. If Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is still available, wait to see if he uses it before following up with decisive attacks.
Vladimir.laning: Poke with Talon W Rake, but save mana early; close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy only when your opponent steps up to last-hit.
Vladimir.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, push the wave and roam with Talon E Assassin's Path to apply pressure. As the game goes on, Talon's impact falls off and Vladimir scales, so keep applying pressure to end the game while you have the advantage.
Vladimir.teamfight: Choose a target before the teamfight and focus Talon's abilities on one enemy. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allies; if approaching from the front is difficult, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path. Don’t group inside the range of Vladimir R Hemoplague, and if you are infected, engage after its effect ends.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir W Sanguine Pool interrupts target selection and removes incoming projectiles, so don’t use decisive abilities before the pool ends. When you see Vladimir charging E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If you are infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you take increased damage, so re-engage after the effect ends.

Xerath.build: Prioritize a way to cleanse or remove the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. Build movement speed to leave marked attack areas and magic resistance against his damage; don’t prioritize armor to block Xerath’s ability damage.
Xerath.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then land both the outgoing and returning strikes of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with an auto attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the window to engage is right after Xerath E Shocking Orb’s stun and Xerath W Eye of Destruction’s slow are down. Close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path.
Xerath.fight: Right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path. Once you are on him, trigger Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack, then back off.
Xerath.laning: With Talon’s short range, don’t step forward first. Poke with Talon W Rake, then close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Xerath steps up to last-hit. Farm while avoiding heavy damage and wait for Xerath to run out of mana; then push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your roaming and burst damage become stronger, so push the lane and pressure side lanes with Talon E Assassin's Path. Talon's impact falls off later in the game, so keep pressuring while you have the advantage.
Xerath.teamfight: Choose a target before engaging and focus your abilities on one enemy. After the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allies, flank the backline with Talon E Assassin's Path, and save Talon R Shadow Assault’s stealth to escape.
Xerath.watch: If you are stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb, you can take the full follow-up, so be especially careful of that shot. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging it, change direction and dodge to the side. Also dodge the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Keep in mind that armor cannot block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: For a reliable hit, close in first with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then land both the outgoing and returning strikes of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with an auto attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End. Hold Talon W Rake while Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks it.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he briefly has no way to knock you up, creating an opening to engage. Before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy alongside the slow from Talon W Rake. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has a short cooldown, so don’t assume he has lost his escape just because he used it once.
Yasuo.fight: First remove the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with Talon W Rake poke, then trade seriously. Engage right after Yasuo throws his tornado: close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, land both strikes of Talon W Rake at close range, then trigger Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack.
Yasuo.laning: Because of Talon’s short range, don’t step forward first; close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy when Yasuo steps up to last-hit. Manage the wave so it stays thin and pushes toward your side to reduce the minion footholds Yasuo can use to dash in with E Sweeping Blade. Talon W Rake costs a lot of mana early, so don’t spam it to poke.
Yasuo.phase: If Yasuo reaches the next level first, don’t step forward during that window. After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, push the wave and roam with Talon E Assassin's Path, keeping up pressure before your impact falls off later in the game.
Yasuo.teamfight: Choose one target before going in and focus Talon's abilities on them. After enemy crowd control, such as Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado, has been used on your allies, flank with Talon E Assassin's Path. If possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault to help you escape.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move to the side to dodge when Yasuo approaches. After he lands it twice in a row, his next Q becomes a tornado that knocks you up, so watch the sound and visual effect and manage your distance. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is in front of you, hold Talon W Rake and wait for the wall to disappear or for a chance to go around it.

Yone.build: Prioritize movement speed so it is easier to dodge the marked areas of Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone W Spirit Cleave. Don’t focus resistance on just one type. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Yone.combo: For a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, throw Talon W Rake at close range, and land both its outgoing and returning strikes before triggering Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack. For a faster combo, throw Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then follow with an auto attack. In this sequence, don’t auto attack before Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy.
Yone.escape: Engage during the window when Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado has disappeared and Yone E Soul Unbound and R Fate Sealed are down. Don’t rush in if only one mobility ability is down, since he can escape with the remaining one. If you use Talon R Shadow Assault to engage, you lose its stealth as an escape tool, so only do this when you are sure you can secure the kill.
Yone.fight: Engage after Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado stacks disappear and Yone E Soul Unbound or R Fate Sealed is down. When Yone steps forward to last-hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, land both strikes of Talon W Rake, trigger Talon P Blade's End with an auto attack, then back off.
Yone.laning: Don’t step forward if Yone has reached the next level first or Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready. Talon W Rake costs a lot of mana, so save enough for a kill opportunity. When pushing the wave to roam, clear enemy vision or use Talon E Assassin's Path along a route without vision.
Yone.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, use the period when your roaming and burst damage are stronger to apply pressure. Talon's impact falls off as the game goes on, so create chances to end the game while you have the advantage.
Yone.teamfight: Choose one target before engaging, then flank with Talon E Assassin's Path after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allies. Focus your abilities on that target and save Talon R Shadow Assault’s stealth to escape. Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit multiple people, and don’t stand alone in the back against Yone R Fate Sealed.
Yone.watch: When Yone Q Mortal Steel hits minions and builds stacks, he is preparing to engage with a tornado, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear. When Yone dives in with E Soul Unbound, he can deal extra damage when he returns, so retreat early if your health is low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so don’t stand alone in the back just before a teamfight.

Zed.build: Build armor early against the main damage from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Zed.combo: After Zed W Living Shadow is down, for a reliable hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and land both strikes of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with an auto attack to trigger Talon P Blade's End. For a faster combo, throw Talon W Rake first and close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, but don’t auto attack beforehand.
Zed.escape: Don’t engage just because Zed W Living Shadow is down; check whether Zed can still use R Death Mark. Before Zed R Death Mark comes back up, close the gap with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin's Path if the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already swapped positions.
Zed.fight: Trade when Zed W Living Shadow has disappeared or after Zed has already swapped positions with the shadow. When he steps forward to last-hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, fully stack Talon P Blade's End with your abilities, then trigger it with an auto attack and back off.
Zed.laning: Talon has short range, so don’t step forward first; poke with Talon W Rake. When roaming, push the wave and cross a wall on a route without vision with Talon E Assassin's Path.
Zed.phase: After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your roaming and burst damage become stronger, but Zed peaks in the mid game, so group with your allies to avoid getting caught alone then. Both champions lose impact later in the game, so keep pressuring while Talon has the advantage.
Zed.teamfight: Choose one target before the teamfight and focus your abilities on them. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your allies, and if possible, save Talon R Shadow Assault’s stealth to escape. If approaching from the front is difficult, flank the backline with Talon E Assassin's Path.
Zed.watch: While Zed W Living Shadow’s shadow remains, watch out for both his movement and attacks. Check the shadow’s position and move outside the slow area of Zed E Shadow Slash. If you are marked by Zed R Death Mark, create distance so Zed cannot keep stacking damage on you.

Zoe.build: Buy a Control Ward first to secure vision along roam routes and around objectives. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Zoe’s damage, but rely on health to withstand the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Prioritize dodging the bubble over building more resistance.
Zoe.combo: When you can land it reliably, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, then hit both the outgoing and returning strikes of Talon W Rake at close range. Follow with a basic attack to trigger Talon P Blade’s End. For a quick combo, cast Talon W Rake first, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy just before it returns, then basic attack.
Zoe.escape: Right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is your chance to go in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or E Assassin's Path. If you engage with Talon E Assassin's Path, decide in advance which terrain you’ll cross to escape.
Zoe.fight: Close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and fight right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. If Zoe uses R Portal Jump, be sure to target the starting spot she must return to. Once you start the trade, trigger Talon P Blade's End with a basic attack, then disengage.
Zoe.laning: Talon has short range, so chip away at Zoe’s health with Talon W Rake instead of walking forward first. When Zoe walks up to last-hit, close in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy. When you push the wave and roam, clear the enemy’s vision or choose a path without vision, then cross a wall with Talon E Assassin’s Path.
Zoe.phase: If you gave up the level advantage, don’t walk forward during that time. After learning Talon R Shadow Assault, your roaming and burst become stronger, but Talon’s impact falls as the game goes longer, so keep up the pressure while you have the advantage.
Zoe.teamfight: Engage after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down and the enemy has used their crowd control on an ally. Use Talon E Assassin’s Path to flank, focus Zoe as a single target, and concentrate your abilities on her. It’s safer to save the stealth from Talon R Shadow Assault for your escape.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, sleep triggers after a short delay, making it easy for Zoe Q Paddle Star! to hit you while you’re asleep. If hit, move behind a wall or an ally before sleep triggers, so you wake up outside Zoe Q’s angle. Even a missed bubble remains as a trap, so be careful in narrow paths without vision.
